answers.Q1: Sixteen volumes were listed in the intake register.
answers.Q2: Cart 2 delivered the largest number, with six volumes.
answers.Q3: The clerk attached a pale cross-reference slip recording the competing shelf reference.
answers.Q4: Porter Ede Halstrom physically unloaded cart 3 at the archive entrance.
answers.Q5: Bindery assistant Rona Fisk supplied the narrow green bands.
answers.Q6: One volume remained in the review cabinet when the exercise ended.
